note: KNOWN FAILURE, kept deliberately. The heuristic pre-filter matches the activity word 'event' inside this newsletter and then titles the draft from the subject, so it proposes an event where there is none. A title-only draft can never be approved (CreateEventDtoValidator requires StartAt, EndAt and VenueName), so the practical cost is one wasted review rather than a wrong publish - but it is a real false positive and the report should keep showing it. Do not 'fix' the key to make the number look better.
subject: September club newsletter
body:
September newsletter

Hello members,

Thanks to everyone who came along last month. This month we are pleased to welcome two new sponsors, and our social page has photos from the June event.

Committee
